The *Dassanahetuttika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 23.27) is an Abhidhamma text classified as a leaf section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh book of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. As reflected in its title, the text examines conditional relations at the intersection of the triad concerning roots abandoned by vision (*dassanahetuttika*) and the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].

Neither SuttaCentral nor DharmaNexus records any extant parallels in Chinese, Tibetan, or Sanskrit corpora [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
